scope: Bounded profile-document and stopped file/UI maintenance, plus one own x64 virtual assigned session for unavailable controls and connected read-only JSON operations.

builds.note: Runtime gates execute x64 GUI/MCP/target. i686 image was built/copied and hashed but is not exercised by this group. Native v3 runtime is unchanged from the prior accepted Output Rules gate.

accepted: Standalone 22-tool object-schema discovery without DLLs; modern two-seat graph/output/bounds/annotation/magnifier fields roundtrip structurally; decimal output-key maps survive buffered JSON; legacy IDs materialize once and remain stable.
Invalid JSON/version/cyclic graph/output rules and a UTF-8 document exceeding 16 MiB reject while standalone session state stays unchanged; a same-sized oversized file import preserves draft/files.

Actual stopped Save keeps exact previous validated bytes in .bak; Import and separate-path Export preserve full profiles; successful Restore replaces the draft/main and backs up exact prior main. Representative staged Output and graph drafts reset on replacement.
Reset changes only the draft; actual Undo restores the complete prior profile; a second Undo is visibly disabled and never clicked.

Invalid backup and invalid existing main fail preflight without changing main, backup or draft. One real own handle lacking FILE_SHARE_DELETE denies final Windows replacement: main and draft stay unchanged, backup becomes exact validated prior main, temporary file is cleaned; unlocked Save/Export/Load then succeeds.

One active virtual session renders all seven maintenance controls disabled/visible with truthful non-click observations, preserving actual F5 hold and files/draft. Connected MCP validate/normalize/export and invalid document rejection cause no native input, worker configuration, profile or file-export change. Stop delivers plain F5 UP and destroys overlay/descriptor.

counts.note: Step occurrences include repeated navigation/setup and are not distinct feature counts. The substantive equivalent-profile comparisons are grouped, not inflated.

retained_failure.accepted_scope: Only its 19 recorded passed clicks through Reset. Its subsequent Undo is not counted; the tail independently verifies actual Undo.
retained_failure.cause: The reused graph-only harness required an unresolved-ID warning for a disabled Undo and could not continue past disabled observations. Bounded opt-in Script instrumentation now records visible disabled responses without click/product dispatch; default scripts retain click-only behavior.

limits: Only virtual IDs, owned files/apps and own GUI pixels. No hardware/RustDesk input used for control or validation and no OS input injection; no general hardware, arbitrary-app, full parity or multi-user isolation claim.

Synthetic nonzero PIDs in offline profiles are validation/persistence data only and were never attached. Profile validation does not establish current PID authorization; the active phase uses its actual owned target PID.

Main and backup are individually atomic files, not a two-file transaction. Backup may update before failed main replacement. No crash/power-loss recovery, concurrent-writer stress, other filesystems or exhaustive near-limit serialization expansion testing.

Dependent editor reset is exercised for Output and graph drafts; other editor reset paths are not independently exhaustively tested. Historical feature delivery suites, OS startup/tray and unrelated migrations are not replayed.

producer_checks.scope: Producer fmt, strict Clippy, 114 tests and both builds; distinct from this independent runtime gate.

image.independent_visual_review: Safe own GUI: Save/Load, Import/Export, Restore backup, Reset/Undo, stale-PID reminder and backup path all visible; no unrelated window inventory.
